buildings.name: Temple of the Land
buildings.description: Religious building; eligible units and research depend on faction.

faction_descriptions.nephites: Nephite Temple; trains Teachers of the Word and supports Favor.
faction_descriptions.lamanites: Rameumptom; trains Priestcrafters and researches Order of the Nehors and By the Pride of Their Hearts.
faction_descriptions.laban: Great and Spacious Building; generates 2.5 Drunkenness/s, or 3/s with Fermented Reserves; weakens enemies within 8m; limit one.

buildings.name: Tents and Habitations
buildings.description: Housing that adds the population listed in its definition.

buildings.name: Tower of Watchmen
buildings.description: Defensive tower with vision and attack.

buildings.name: Winery
buildings.description: Laban religious building; trains Drunken Concubines and generates 0.5 Drunkenness/s.

factions.name: Nephites
factions.description: Nephite covenant army. Teachers convert eligible enemies in 5 seconds; converted units cannot be converted again.

factions.name: Lamanites
factions.description: Lamanite mass armies and Zoramite elites. No Watchtowers; converted units cannot be converted again.
